name: Owl Wing Thicket
summary: In southern Winterspring, berserk, moontouched, and crazed owlbeasts prowl the snowy crags of Owl Wing Thicket. Its caves and stone roosts hold ancient night elf altars tied to their origins and to Elune.

sections.title: Sanctuary of the Moonkin
sections.body:
South of Everlook, Owl Wing Thicket is among Winterspring’s densest owlbeast nesting grounds. Long ago, night elf caretakers revered the creatures as sacred guardians blessed by Elune.

Ancient shrines and moonstone altars remain beneath the cavern overhangs. The lingering spirits of the Guardians of Elune watch over them. Many owlbeasts have fallen to madness and attack travelers who trespass in their holy hollows.

sections.title: The Lore of the Moonkin
sections.body:
At Owl Wing Thicket, night elf scholars and priests seek communion with the Guardians of Elune. The priestess Ranshalla guides Alliance seekers as they light sacred braziers throughout the caves to awaken the ancient spirits.

The guardians tell how Elune first fashioned wild moonkin to protect pristine natural sanctuaries. Their words reveal the beasts’ divine ancestry, though many are now feral and hostile.

faq.answer: In southern Winterspring, Owl Wing Thicket’s snowy crags and caves shelter a dense population of wild owlbeasts. Ancient shrines there honor Elune, the night elf goddess.

faq.q: Why are the owlbeasts here so aggressive?
faq.answer: Elune blessed the owlbeasts as protectors of nature, but many have fallen into violent frenzy. Berserk, moontouched, and crazed beasts roam Owl Wing Thicket and attack anyone who approaches their dens.
Ranshalla is a night elf priestess of Elune who journeys into Owl Wing Thicket. She seeks the ancient Guardians of Elune to learn the sacred origins and history of the moonkin.

faq.q: What are the Guardians of Elune found inside the thicket?
faq.answer: The Guardians of Elune are ancient night elf spirits tied to altars within the caves. Rekindling sacred fires summons them, and they tell how the moonkin were created to watch over wild and holy lands.

angles.text: For the Kaldorei, Owl Wing Thicket is holy ground gone wild. Early accounts of Elune’s grace endure there beside feral moonkin that have lost their ancient balance.
As a druid, you hold the owlbeast form sacred. Owl Wing Thicket is a sobering place, where creatures gifted with lunar affinity have fallen into unrestrained madness.
